title: Run snapshot header (ADR-0123 доп. (1) п. 2, доп. (2) п. 1)
description: Passport of a run snapshot. commit: implementation SHA the stand ran; spec: export pin; runner: runner pin; profile: stand profile; targets, steps: executed by the run, sorted, without repeats; inputs: sha256 of the saved journal and passport the snapshot was extracted from. Repeated extraction from inputs with these hashes gives the same bytes; two runs are compared by meaning (runsnap.py diff), not byte for byte.
